steps.step: three fresh repositories started (R1, R2 independent; R3 evidence carrier)
case 1 honest extension (seq1 + seq2) → CONSISTENT at seq2, NO proof emitted
case 1b pin created at seq2 AND retains the exact identity witness; admission intact
case 2 same-sequence divergence across repositories → CONFLICT + verified proof core; resolve still byte-identical read-only
case 2b the core verifies offline: canonical pair, declared heads, derived relation, content address
case 3 non-extending branching at different sequences → NONEXTENDING_FORK; ancestor and strict-extension pairs never yield a proof
case 4 local-history fork proven from the RETAINED pin witness (no peer); extension is no proof and a witness-less pin refuses honestly
case 5 carrier-authored tampering (7 independent corruptions) → every one INVALID offline
case 5b ingest independently verifies before recording — a forged core is refused and records nothing
case 6 the carrier holds no authoritative state; the core a carrier forwards verifies byte-identically at the receiving consumer
case 7 withholding: one branch only → PARTIAL with no proof (limitation demonstrated, not hidden)
case 8 D disagreement with comparable histories → content CONFLICT, no F1 proof
case 8b D conflict AND a genuine history fork → the identity proof is emitted regardless of the D conflict

result.reason: valid P2 observations disagree on D

steps.step: case 9 three conflicting branches in different order → identical canonical pair, core bytes and digest; annotations never bind
case 10 ingest quarantines; a new P2 import refuses with the dedicated code BEFORE any pin mutation
case 10b acknowledgment keeps the evidence, alters neither pin nor branch selection, and lifts quarantine
case 10c a second unacknowledged proof re-quarantines and blocks imports again
case 11 an offline process with no peers/config computes the identical digest and verdict
case 11b an independent machine verifies the transported core to the identical digest (and rejects a tampered copy)

verdict: F1 MATRIX GREEN — equivocation evidence is portable, offline-verifiable, and locally actionable; carriers add zero authority
